name: srt-caption-track
title: SRT Caption Track
description: Renders captions straight from SubRip or WebVTT text: each cue is spread across its words, grouped into pages, and the spoken word is highlighted.
useWhen: You have an .srt or .vtt subtitle export and want styled, highlighted captions without word timestamps: paste the file text into the variable.
Subtitles come from a translator or an editor, not from a word-timed transcript.
avoidWhen: You have word-level timings (a transcript): use a word-timed caption block such as caption-karaoke, which is exact.
You need speaker names or two languages: use speaker-label-captions or subtitle-translate.
author: RemotionUI

variables.label: Subtitles
variables.description: SubRip (.srt) or WebVTT (.vtt) text, timestamps included.
variables.default:
1
00:00:00,300 --> 00:00:02,600
Good captions are easy to read.

2
00:00:03,000 --> 00:00:05,800
Timing is split across the words of each line.

3
00:00:06,200 --> 00:00:08,600
So the highlight follows along.

variables.label: Word timing
variables.description: SRT has no word times: distribute spreads a cue over its words by length; cue keeps each cue as one token and shows it whole.

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words of one cue that start within this window share one page; a page never spans two cues. 3000 keeps a typical cue on one page, lower splits it into shorter pages.

variables.label: Offset
variables.description: Shift every caption later (positive) or earlier (negative).

variables.label: Hold pages
variables.description: Keep a page on screen until the next one starts.

variables.label: Active weight
variables.description: Weight of the word being spoken.

variables.label: Active color
variables.description: Colour of the word being spoken.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow for legibility over footage.
